title: How to Remember New Words: 3 Easy Steps That Make Them Stick
description:
Learn a new word on Monday, lose it by Friday? Here are three easy steps that make new words stick, plus a 5-word challenge: see the words at the start, then take the test at the end.

1. Use the word: write one sentence about your own life and say it out loud.
2. Learn it inside a sentence, and learn when to use it and when to avoid it.
3. Get the timing right: cover the answer, recall it, and review on days 1, 3 and 7.

Then a 15-minute daily routine that puts all three together. No app needed.

Comment your score from the 5-word test, plus one sentence using your favourite of the five words.

More ways to say "happy": https://anotherwordfor.net/another-word-for-happy/

Source: Roediger, H. L., & Karpicke, J. D. (2006). Test-enhanced learning: Taking memory tests improves long-term retention. Psychological Science, 17(3), 249–255. One week later, students who practised recall remembered about 61% of a text; students who re-read it remembered about 40%, with the same study time.
